name: Client Error Telemetry

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_errors WHERE stack_hash = {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate').first().json.stack_hash) }}) AS seen,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_errors WHERE notified = 1 AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS recent

INSERT IGNORE INTO client_errors (session_id, stack_hash, kind, screen, endpoint, status, message, stack, user_agent, app_version, week_date_range, client_time, notified)
VALUES (
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate').first().json.session_id) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate').first().json.stack_hash) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate').first().json.kind) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : JSON.stringify(v))($('Validate').first().json.screen) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : JSON.stringify(v))($('Validate').first().json.endpoint) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : String(Number(v)))($('Validate').first().json.status) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate').first().json.message) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : JSON.stringify(v))($('Validate').first().json.stack) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : JSON.stringify(v))($('Validate').first().json.user_agent) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : JSON.stringify(v))($('Validate').first().json.app_version) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : JSON.stringify(v))($('Validate').first().json.week_date_range) }},
  {{ (v => v == null ? 'NULL' : JSON.stringify(v))($('Validate').first().json.client_time) }},
  {{ (Number($json.seen) === 0 && Number($json.recent) < 10) ? 1 : 0 }}
)
